mission: Mission 3CX - PopSign fresh5 strategy/downscope decision packet

head.subject: observer: ESCALATE - popsign fresh5 post-collapse strategy

scope.purpose: Use M3CW and observer-435 strategy evidence to select exactly one no-training next direction among revised scratch design review, product downscope, and stopping the scratch recognizer lane.

source_supported_observations.observation: M3CW classified the strongest current explanation as current_scratch_architecture_optimization_generalization_failure_under_existing_input_and_data_envelope and selected escalate_strategy_research_with_local_evidence.

The API memo does not authorize training, Brev compute, export, browser activation, model-card promotion, final-gate weakening, source expansion, pseudo-labeling, data mutation, tensor mutation, crop/region-target implementation, architecture/input implementation, or product recognition claims.

The API memo authorizes architecture/input design review only as no-training/no-code-change review, authorizes product downscope analysis only as part of the strategy packet, and says STOP is not selected now but must remain an allowed outcome.
The scratch architecture/input path can train-fit a deterministic balanced one-clip-per-label subset to 1.0 accuracy on 5/5 clips with nonzero gradient and parameter movement.
Data/split, tensor/input, sampler/distribution, and optimizer/loss receipts reduce mechanical explanations for the collapse.
The 20-epoch LR 0.003 bounded local train-all stayed at validation accuracy 0.2, test top-1 0.2, macro F1 0.06666666666666668, and validation/test predictions collapsed to morning:125.
Train, validation, and test logits collapse to morning:125 top-1 and thank_you:125 top-2 with stable class ordering morning > thank_you > who > pen > home.
Train linear_input_post_layernorm features are nonseparable with feature variance mean 2.7852715663804345e-8, between/within centroid ratio 0.3116968095914498, and nearest-centroid accuracy 0.224.

Train head_input_fused_pre_layernorm features are already collapsed before LayerNorm/readout, with variance mean 0.00017123778903535984, between/within centroid ratio 0.3368962860376266, and nearest-centroid accuracy 0.176.
web/public/model/model-card.json has status not_trained and says automatic sign checks fail closed.
docs/model/active-vocabulary-claim.json has modelVersion rawframe-not-trained, activeLabels [], and evidenceArtifacts [].

reviewer_inference: Another fitting run under the current scratch_region_temporal_late_fusion_tcn_contract_v1 envelope is not justified because the failure is visible on the train split, inside the learned representation, and after repeated clean data/tensor/sampler/loss audits.

The current evidence does not prove that no no-pretrained scratch recognizer route can ever work; it proves that the current architecture/input/training envelope is a failed path for the present school-project lane.

Because STOP is not selected by the observer-435 memo and product recognition must remain fail-closed, a no-training revised scratch architecture/input design review is the narrowest next recognizer-lane artifact that can preserve optionality without spending compute or changing claims.

Product downscope is likely necessary as a parallel or subsequent planning concern if a new scratch design cannot meet evidence gates, but selecting it now would prematurely leave the recognizer-lane question unanswered after the observer explicitly authorized a no-training design review.
Stopping the scratch recognizer lane now is stronger than the evidence supports because no post-collapse revised design review has yet been written against the M3CR-M3CV failure mode.
why_another_fitting_run_is_not_justified: The train split itself collapses to the same class ordering as validation/test, so this is not only held-out generalization noise.
The feature diagnostics show nonseparable representations before the classifier head and before LayerNorm/readout, so a last-layer or threshold-only response would be downstream.
M3CK-M3CQ reduce the likelihood of simple loader, split, label, tensor, sampler, evaluator, loss, optimizer, or checkpoint-selection defects.
The observer-435 API memo explicitly does not authorize training/fitting or Brev compute and recommends a no-training strategy/downscope decision first.

constraints_restatement.no_pretrained_promoted_lane: No pretrained CV/sign/landmark/model dependencies, generated pseudo-labels, or pretrained embeddings may enter the promoted lane.
constraints_restatement.browser_first_fail_closed: Browser recognition remains fail-closed until a validated trained artifact is exported and promoted through the repo gates.
constraints_restatement.no_raw_learner_upload: Raw learner video must not upload during normal practice.
constraints_restatement.source_legal: Public ASL datasets remain research references unless exact source/legal review clears exact use.
constraints_restatement.brev: Any future paid Brev run requires a separate approved compute receipt with worker state, command, max runtime/spend, kill condition, expected metric signal, copyback/default-off plan, cleanup, duplicate-worker avoidance, and current human approval.
constraints_restatement.final_claims: No final-readiness, browser-recognition, active-label, or model-card claim can be changed by this packet.

pros: Directly addresses the M3CW primary failure axis without running training or changing code.
Keeps the no-pretrained recognizer lane alive only at design-review level after the current architecture envelope failed.
Can specify what must differ from the failed path, including architecture/input assumptions and stop criteria, before any human approval, implementation, or compute discussion.
risks: A design review alone does not prove model learnability.
Future implementation or training would still require separate approval, receipts, gates, and possibly human scope/budget decisions.
option_analysis.authorization_boundary: No implementation, prototype, tensor mutation, fitting, Brev, export, browser activation, or claim change is authorized.

pros: Likely protects the school-project deliverable by centering useful ASL learning flows while recognition remains fail-closed.
Avoids further spend and avoids misleading recognition claims.
risks: Would move away from answering the active recognizer-lane blocker question before a post-collapse design review is written.
Could require later product-claim and UX scope decisions that this executor is not authorized to take.
option_analysis.authorization_boundary: Product downscope analysis is allowed only as a no-recognition plan; no final claims or UI behavior are changed by this packet.

pros: Would prevent further spend and churn if the no-pretrained scratch recognizer route is judged infeasible for the deadline.
risks: Observer-435 explicitly says STOP is not selected now.
Stopping before a post-collapse design review would skip the only currently authorized recognizer-lane alternative to blind fitting.
option_analysis.authorization_boundary: No stop sentinel or durable halt is set by this executor packet.

decision.rationale: The current scratch recognizer path has failed, but observer-435 does not select STOP and explicitly authorizes no-training architecture/input design review. The next defensible recognizer-lane slice is therefore a design-only review that identifies what must differ from the failed architecture/input envelope and what evidence gates would be required before any implementation, fitting, Brev, export, promotion, product claim, or human approval path.

commands_intentionally_not_run: tensor regeneration or manifest/source/register mutation commands
source import, media download, pseudo-labeling, or label expansion commands
export, browser activation, model-card promotion, active-label promotion, or final-gate commands
